headline: Kalpataru Limited: Takeover Disclosure filed under SEBI Regulation 31(4)
sum: Mofatraj P. Munot filed a disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), the standard filing requirement for substantial acquisitions of shares or change in control. The disclosure was submitted to NSE on 30 June 2026 and published by the exchange.
detail: Mofatraj P. Munot submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, to NSE. This is a standard regulatory filing triggered when an acquirer crosses prescribed thresholds of shareholding (typically 5% or above, or when an agreement is entered into to acquire 25% or more). The disclosure document serves as the regulator's first notice of material acquisition activity and gates the timeline for Open Offer compliance. No consideration, target stake percentage, or acquisition structure is stated in the primary NSE disclosure document provided.
